lastCompletedStory.title: Add in-container claude auth probe module

nextStoryContext: src/supervisor/container-auth.ts now exports buildAuthCheckExecArgv(containerName) (['exec', containerName, 'claude', 'auth', 'status', '--json'], no -it, no sudo), applyContainerAuthCheck(containerName, spawnFn) (pure, never throws, returns {ok:true} | {ok:false,exitCode,stderrTail}), and ContainerAuthError (mirrors FirewallError: stderrTail + name='ContainerAuthError'). This module is purely pluggable so far -- nothing in the production ensure-container path calls applyContainerAuthCheck yet, and ContainerAuthError is never thrown anywhere. The next story (per this PRD's shape, presumably US-003) needs to wire applyContainerAuthCheck into the actual container ensure path (mirroring how ensureWorkerContainer in src/supervisor/ensure-container.ts drives applyContainerFirewall + throws FirewallError), and on failure should write the 'container-auth-unavailable' stall reason (already registered by US-001 in src/supervisor/sidecar-stalled.ts) before any worker is dispatched. The AuthCheckSpawnFn type intentionally mirrors FirewallSpawnFn's shape ({stdout,stderr,exitCode}), not ContainerSpawnFn's ({stdout,exitCode} only, no stderr) -- reuse FirewallSpawnFn's DI convention, not worker-container.ts's, when wiring the real spawnSync-backed implementation.
